quarterly_data.quarter: Baker Hughes press release: Baker Hughes and Venture Global Advance Next Phase of U.S. (09-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Venture Global: two new orders. (1) A substantial order for 13 gas compression systems driven by Frame 5/2E gas turbines for the Cloud Connector Pipeline in Louisiana (feed gas to Plaquemines LNG) - the second such order, taking the fleet to 23 Frame 5/2E-driven compression systems for Plaquemines. (2) A major order for four liquefaction blocks (eight liquefaction modules, electric-motor-driven single mixed-refrigerant modules with Baker Hughes centrifugal compressors, including Chart cold boxes) for the Plaquemines LNG expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: 13 Frame 5/2E-driven gas compression systems (fleet of 23); four liquefaction blocks, eight modules
